scenario: Import the repository-owned synthetic LINE screenshot as candidate-owned evidence, bind it to Leila Hartmann and the Chief Product Officer search, review all extracted evidence, keep relative dates unresolved, execute no external action, compile the contact Wiki, and verify persisted readback.
frozen_evidence: manifest.json with commit, fixture digest, runtime boundary, and retained local identifiers
Focused Web tests: 7 files and 68 tests passed
Focused backend tests: 4 files and 15 tests passed
Live OpenRouter gold case line-relative-time-and-explicit-invite-request passed in 19.32 seconds
Full page reload preserved reviewed facts, no-action state, and Wiki snapshot ffd7e0eb
Read-only subject count: Leila Hartmann had 119 active rows in the exercised local database

review_plan.reason: The scenario must be practical and recoverable for a time-constrained recruiter.
The flow binds sensitive conversation evidence to identity and derived relationship state.
No candidate-facing message, notification, rejection, or external action was executed.
The scenario did not score, rank, compare, or assess candidate quality.
The evaluated artifact was the authenticated desktop Web surface.

reviews.lens: Time-constrained independent recruiter completing screenshot-to-contact evidence capture and readback

findings.observation: The identity step presented four visually indistinguishable Leila Hartmann rows with the same relationship context and capture count.
findings.evidence: Direct rendered-browser observation during identity binding; a read-only local database query also found 119 non-deleted subjects with display_label Leila Hartmann.
findings.user_impact: A recruiter cannot confidently choose the intended record and must reconcile duplicates outside the import flow.
findings.recommendation: Deduplicate seeded/test subjects and show stable distinguishing evidence such as verified handle, organization, relationship context, or last interaction before allowing binding.
findings.verification: Repeat the import with two same-name people and prove every selectable row is uniquely distinguishable and that selecting the intended record writes only to that record.

findings.criterion: Operational readiness of the live analysis path
findings.observation: The current local configuration first failed closed because sensitive-AI gates were disabled, then both Zhipu and OpenRouter timed out until the existing HTTPS proxy was explicitly mapped to the provider-specific proxy variable.
findings.evidence: Rendered timeout recovery state plus request IDs 8580d830-c2c3-4e9e-a307-1b8232b28690 and 1bde3dd8-e32e-4da0-8b5e-b3e588ac5e97; the same fixture completed in about 16 seconds after the ephemeral mapping.
findings.user_impact: A recruiter sees a retryable but unusable import path unless an operator knows an undocumented runtime mapping.
findings.recommendation: Validate the selected provider, gates, and proxy reachability at startup and expose one actionable configuration diagnosis without disclosing secrets.
findings.verification: Start from the documented local environment and complete the same fixture without shell-only overrides; separately prove the disabled-provider state remains fail-closed.

findings.observation: The visible Compile Wiki button produced no effect when the Ask objective was empty; entering an objective in the assistant field and submitting compiled the Wiki successfully.
findings.evidence: Direct rendered-browser execution; RelationshipWikiPanel calls relationshipAgent.ask() while the Ask path requires a non-empty objective.
findings.user_impact: The recruiter can mistake a silent no-op for an unavailable or broken evidence compile and must discover an unrelated workaround.
findings.recommendation: Give Compile Wiki its own explicit objective or disable it with an inline explanation and focus the required input.
findings.verification: With an empty Ask field, activate Compile Wiki and observe either a successful compile or an immediate, accessible explanation and guided recovery.

strengths: The successful flow preserved the screenshot as a source, extracted four exact messages, and required explicit speaker, person, and relationship-context review.
Relative Tuesday and Wednesday facts remained needs-clarification, while the existing confirmed availability was not overwritten.
The result honestly showed no evidence-supported action and survived a full page reload.
Provider timeouts retained the local file, crop, and mask state for a safe retry instead of silently saving partial evidence.
missing_evidence: A clean, single-seed environment was not available, so this run cannot separate migration/seed idempotency from long-lived local database pollution.
Deletion and restore of the newly retained synthetic source were not exercised because the requested chain focused on ingest, review, and readback.
No production deployment, mobile UI, or real recruiter workload was evaluated.
open_questions: Which stable identity fields are guaranteed to be available before screenshot binding when two people share the same display name?
Should Compile Wiki be a one-click operation independent of the assistant question field?

reviews.lens: Identity, provenance, uncertainty, sensitive-model exposure, authority, and reversibility in screenshot evidence capture

findings.criterion: Identity binding must be meaningfully reviewable
findings.observation: The required human identity decision offered four indistinguishable Leila Hartmann targets; the rendered rows did not provide enough evidence to tell which subject would receive the screenshot.
findings.evidence: Direct browser observation at binding time and a read-only query showing 119 active Leila Hartmann subject rows in the exercised local database.
findings.user_impact: Message-level evidence can be attached to the wrong person even though the UI technically records a human click, contaminating the wrong relationship history and downstream Wiki state.
findings.recommendation: Block binding when candidate identity choices are not uniquely distinguishable; require a stable differentiator or an explicit merge/create-new resolution with provenance before commit.
findings.verification: Create two same-name subjects, import one screenshot, and prove the UI exposes sufficient stable identity evidence, rejects an unresolved ambiguous selection, and leaves the non-selected subject unchanged.

findings.criterion: Sensitive provider configuration and fail-closed behavior
findings.observation: Sensitive AI processing was disabled by default and provider requests timed out without a provider-specific proxy mapping; the product did fail closed and stated that no source was saved.
findings.evidence: Rendered configuration and timeout states, followed by a successful synthetic-only run after ephemeral gate and proxy configuration.
findings.user_impact: The safe failure avoids unauthorized retention, but environment drift can make operators repeatedly transmit a synthetic or authorized screenshot without understanding whether the provider is reachable.
findings.recommendation: Add a non-sensitive readiness check that distinguishes disabled consent gates, missing provider configuration, and network timeout before screenshot transmission.
findings.verification: Exercise each configuration state and prove no source is created, no raw image is retained, and the UI names the recoverable cause without exposing credentials.

strengths: Only a repository-owned synthetic screenshot was used, and the product stated that the original image remained in browser memory rather than being stored as a server copy.
The model output remained proposed evidence until explicit person/context binding and evidence review.
Four messages retained speaker attribution and exact text; relative dates were visibly marked needs-clarification instead of being promoted to confirmed state.
No calendar or messaging action was proposed because date and timezone were not anchored, and no external write was executed.
The prior confirmed availability survived the import, while the unresolved deadline and availability remained separately reviewable after reload.
Provider failures were fail-closed and preserved a reversible local retry state.
missing_evidence: The run did not exercise source deletion, derived Wiki invalidation, restore, or audit export for the new capture.
The run did not inspect third-party provider retention beyond the application's configured request boundary.
The exact cause of duplicate subjects was not diagnosed because this evaluation was authorized to test, not repair, the flow.
vetoes: Indistinguishable duplicate person records can receive the screenshot without a differentiating identity review.
open_questions: What invariant prevents two active subjects in one account from remaining indistinguishable at evidence-binding time?
Does deleting a source invalidate or recompile every Wiki statement derived from it while preserving the audit trail?

top_findings.criterion: Identity binding must be meaningfully reviewable
top_findings.reason: The current person picker allows sensitive screenshot evidence to be attached through an ambiguous human click among indistinguishable records.
top_findings.next_step: Block ambiguous identity binding and add stable distinguishing evidence or an explicit merge/create-new resolution.
top_findings.verification: Use two same-name subjects and prove unresolved ambiguity cannot commit, the intended subject receives the source exactly once, and the other subject is unchanged.

top_findings.criterion: Operational readiness of the live analysis path
top_findings.reason: The documented local runtime could not complete provider analysis without ephemeral gate and proxy overrides.
top_findings.next_step: Add provider readiness validation and a documented, secret-safe local configuration path.
top_findings.verification: Complete the live gold scenario from a clean documented setup and separately prove disabled and unreachable providers fail closed.

top_findings.reason: Compile Wiki is a silent no-op unless an unrelated Ask objective has already been entered.
top_findings.next_step: Make the compile control self-contained or guide the missing prerequisite accessibly.
top_findings.verification: Activate Compile Wiki with an empty Ask field and observe deterministic success or explicit guided recovery.

agreements: The successful path preserves source, proposal, confirmed state, and action authority as separate layers.
Relative time remained unresolved and therefore produced no new action or external effect.
Timeouts failed closed, kept the local retry state, and did not claim that a source had been saved.
The persisted contact and Wiki readback is credible for the selected local subject but cannot cure ambiguity in selecting that subject.

veto_resolution.veto: Indistinguishable duplicate person records can receive the screenshot without a differentiating identity review.
veto_resolution.evidence: Four indistinguishable Leila rows were rendered during binding, and 119 active Leila Hartmann subjects existed in the exercised local database. No differentiating identity review prevented commit.

adjudication.rationale: The extraction, uncertainty handling, no-action decision, and persisted readback behaved safely once the provider was reachable. Release remains blocked because explicit human authorization is not meaningful when the identity choices are indistinguishable; that can attach sensitive evidence to the wrong person.

next_tests.evidence_required: Rendered picker rows, selected subject ID, committed source owner, audit event, and unchanged non-selected subject.
next_tests.pass_condition: Ambiguous choices cannot commit; distinguishable selection commits exactly once to the intended subject.

next_tests.test: Clean-environment live provider readiness and recovery
next_tests.evidence_required: Startup readiness result plus successful, disabled, unreachable, timeout, and retry screenshots without credential disclosure.
next_tests.pass_condition: The documented setup completes the live gold case, and every failure state is correctly diagnosed and fail-closed.

next_tests.evidence_required: Keyboard and pointer browser recordings, accessible status announcement, resulting Wiki snapshot, and focused component test.
next_tests.pass_condition: The visible control never silently no-ops and produces a deterministic, accessible result.

next_tests.test: Delete, invalidate, audit, and restore the retained synthetic source
next_tests.evidence_required: Source lifecycle events, derived Wiki state before and after deletion, restore behavior, and audit export.
next_tests.pass_condition: Deletion and restore preserve identity, provenance, reversibility, and derived-state truth without resurrecting unsupported claims.
